name: identity-version-unrecognised-rejected
description: identity_version present but naming a version this parser does not implement (spec2) is refused.
notes: unsupported_identity_version is checked at the strict parse stage, before schema validation. An input vector starts execution at schema validation (see schemas/vectors/README.md, input vs input_bytes), so it never reaches the version gate -- this vector must use input_bytes to genuinely exercise it.
